notes: S2-FIX6 (decision 2026-11-16 #13; §5.3 rooted material; review B medium-3): two human declarations, each self-signed and cosigned only by the other's key; the manifest is signed by the first key alone. Material is the least fixed point: a declaration's other signature is verified only against material that does not depend on the declaration itself, so neither supplies material, both cosignatures are unverified (E_KEY_UNKNOWN, N_KEY_UNDECLARED) and the manifest entry is an undeclared key's: E_KEY_UNKNOWN. Assuming both supply material would verify every signature.
